svg.title: Parts list
svg.desc: Backend: Java, Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Apache Camel, Node.js, NestJS, Go, Python, C#. Data And Streaming: Kafka with Connect, Debezium and Streams, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, Neo4j, Spark. Cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker. Frontend: React, Angular, Astro, TypeScript, Next.js. Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo.
